verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs describe a public marketplace/search page where GPU offers and prices are visible without contacting sales (search filters by GPU type, marketplace pricing, competitive pricing claims), but a hands-on community report explicitly contradicts ease of access, saying it takes 'many clicks' to find even an approximate price and that 'prices should be easiest to find.' This is a concrete hands-on complaint about the exact story (public visibility of per-GPU pricing), not just general skepticism. missing for 10: a dedicated static pricing table listing rate per GPU type, resolution of the community friction complaint, independent corroboration that prices are easy to find without navigating the search UI.
